thread:
lee: We need an expedited hotfix deploy for prod-embeds. Staging showed kv-cache leak under long sessions, spikes mem. PR https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4920 image=redwood/embeds:v2026.03.21-hotfix
anya: Can you summarise risk and rollback?
lee: Risk: OOM/eviction on busy hosts. Blast radius: prod-embeds only. Rollback plan: immediate rollback to v2026.03.20 if >1 OOM/m or errors >2% for 10m. Command: `deploy-bot rollback service=prod-embeds to_image=redwood/embeds:v2026.03.20`
infra-oncall: I need 10% canary for 10m with tracing check. I'll enable alerts and watch. Approving: infra-oncall :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: queued rollout: service=prod-embeds image=redwood/embeds:v2026.03.21-hotfix strategy=canary(10%/10m) requested_by=lee
lee: Smoke checklist: `./ops/smoke/embeds.sh --canary` and check RSS on hosts.
releasebot: Draft note created: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-21-hotfix-kvcache (please add blurb)
anya: Approving pending canary green. Approving: anya :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: canary started: 10% -> 2 pods updated. Eval at +10m.
infra-oncall: 6m in: no OOMs, p95 +8ms, 5xx 0.2%. Traces show guard executed.
deploy-bot: canary passed -> ramping 25% -> 50% -> 100% with short holds
deploy-bot: rollout complete: prod-embeds -> redwood/embeds:v2026.03.21-hotfix at 7393000065
lee: Post-deploy: first 15m clean. I'll update release note and open follow-up ticket to add unit test.
releasebot: published: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-21-hotfix-kvcache published_by=lee
